MANILA, Philippines — Face-to-face classes are suspended in parts of Luzon on Thursday, September 10, amid heavy rains brought by the persistence of the southwest monsoon, locally known as habagat.

The following areas have announced class suspensions:

Pampanga

  • San Simon – no face-to-face classes; all levels; public and private (except Concepcion Integrated School); until Friday, Sept. 11
  • Sto. Tomas – no face-to-face classes; all levels; public and private (until Saturday, Sept. 12)
  • Masantol – no face-to-face classes; all levels; public and private

Benguet

  • Kibungan – no face-to-face classes for daycare

Following an announcement from Malacañang, government offices and schools in Metro Manila and 13 provinces were also directed to adopt alternative work and learning arrangements.

Under Memorandum Circular No. 135 issued by the Office of the President on Sept. 10, the areas are as follows:

  • Metro Manila
  • La Union
  • Pangasinan
  • Benguet
  • Bataan
  • Bulacan
  • Pampanga
  • Zambales
